The library lists Triceps Pushdown as low load on the elbow, and I couldn't find a triceps exercise that's gentler. So the best swap is to skip direct triceps work today.

⚠️ Your presses still work the triceps, so keep the weight light and stop if the pain is sharp or doesn't go away. If it lasts, get it checked by a professional.
